A01.title: SCN-001 standalone run: menu (VIS-011/002/014, a11y), inline mentions; the send adds no collaborator and no row (AC-001); the stored message carries the delegate_task note and the UI a chip (AC-002); the host delegates (delegate_task card) and gets an ad-hoc Task, text only (AC-003, AC-015); the delegated row appears; the copy reports "From Code Reviewer:"; the copy view and direct chat; a Team is delegated the same way

A02.title: SCN-002 / AC-007 / AC-009: the user tells the host the review is finished; the host (no Project tool selected) calls create_or_update_task by task_id alone; the Task is DONE, the copy closed, its row leaves live; the Team copy stays; history is kept
A02.error: the open Team copy must stay

A03.title: AC-008 / SCN-004: Stop → reopen: the closed copy stays hidden, the open Team copy is listed, viewing does not restore; a second @Code Reviewer is delegated to a new copy (never the closed one)
A03.error: after Stop: closed copy hidden, open Team copy listed

A04.title: AC-008 real backend restart: the closed copy stays hidden and fenced, open copies are listed; after the restart the host marks the Team work DONE and its rows leave
A04.error: after restart: one (open) Code Reviewer row and the Team rows
